@proboltuk X @harrison_dessoy55 
-
I am delighted to announce that Pro-Bolt UK have come onboard as a sponsor for the remainder of the 2026 season! 
-
Pro Bolt are a premium performance fasteners company delivering Titanium, Stainless Steel, Aluminium Bolts and Kits in a motorcycle racing, motorsport with high performance engineering parts. With their product trusted by multiple World Championship teams in MotoGP and World Superbikes, it is a privilege to have them onboard this year! 
-
Thank you 🙏 @proboltuk
-
www.pro-bolt.com

Day 3 ✅
WU: P13 
Race 2: P3 🔥
-
Incredible. Sums it up 🤣. What a fantastic race 2 here in Aragon. Fighting in the front group with some very experienced riders and coming out on the podium was something special. 
-
In moments like these, I’d like to say a huge thank you to my family, sponsors and the @phrperformance team for putting such an strong bike out in a super competitive field, thank you team 💪🏻. 
-
All eyes forward to Misano in 2 weeks time, a track I haven’t ridden, but I look forward to carrying this momentum forward!
